description: This file defines the CapabilitiesWorker class, a background worker for periodically refreshing capabilities data for user accounts in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages work scheduling, performs network requests to update account capabilities, and handles specific HTTP response scenarios.

classes.name: CapabilitiesWorker
classes.description: A worker class that periodically fetches and updates account capabilities in the background.

methods.name: CapabilitiesWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker with context and parameters.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the background task of updating capabilities for all accounts, handling specific HTTP response cases.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Schedules the periodic execution of the capabilities update worker.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Cancels any existing scheduled workers with the specific tag.
